svg.title: A Favorable Determination Is Not Collected Cash
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-nested-dispute-cash-cohort; chart type: funnel; title: A Favorable Determination Is Not Collected Cash; subtitle: One fixed referral cohort, five nested counts, one observation date.; chapter number: 6; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Illustrative cohort counts, not observed performance or the canonical annual revenue model. Every stage is a subset of the preceding stage. Negotiated settlements leave this arbitration funnel and enter a separate collection ledger. Unpaid awards remain receivables or disputed items, not earned contingency revenue under this cash-conditioned model.; caption: The example has 420 favorable determinations but only 280 cases with incremental cash received: a 66.7% paid share of favorable cases and a 28.0% referral-to-cash conversion.; stages: label: Referred claims; value: 1,000 source claims; numeric value: 1000.0; detail: Freeze a dated intake cohort with unique claim identifiers, provider authority, payer remittance records, and bank reconciliation links; count each dispute unit once.; label: Federal-eligible claims; value: 700 of 1,000; 70.0%; numeric value: 700.0; detail: Document federal eligibility and usable records for 700 claims. Exclude the other 300 from this cohort's federal filing path because routing or documentation requirements were not satisfied.; label: Timely initiated disputes; value: 560 of 700; 80.0%; numeric value: 560.0; detail: Carry 560 unresolved, timely initiated disputes forward after open negotiation. The remaining 140 include settlements and operational exits; track their outcomes separately rather than labeling them arbitration losses.; label: Favorable determinations; value: 420 of 560; 75.0%; numeric value: 420.0; detail: Record 420 favorable determinations by the observation date. Split the other 140 among pending, adverse, and dismissed cases in the case ledger; do not treat every non-favorable observation as a final merits loss.; label: Incremental cash received; value: 280 of 420; 66.7%; numeric value: 280.0; detail: Match incremental receipts for 280 favorable cases to bank activity. The other 140 favorable cases have no matched incremental cash at this cutoff. Partial receipts support fees only on their actual net collected amount.

text.title: A Favorable Determination Is Not Collected Cash
text.tspan: A Favorable Determination Is Not Collected Cash

circle.title: label: Referred claims; value: 1,000 source claims; numeric value: 1000.0; detail: Freeze a dated intake cohort with unique claim identifiers, provider authority, payer remittance records, and bank reconciliation links; count each dispute unit once.

label: Federal-eligible claims; value: 700 of 1,000; 70.0%; numeric value: 700.0; detail: Document federal eligibility and usable records for 700 claims. Exclude the other 300 from this cohort's federal filing path because routing or documentation requirements were not satisfied.

label: Timely initiated disputes; value: 560 of 700; 80.0%; numeric value: 560.0; detail: Carry 560 unresolved, timely initiated disputes forward after open negotiation. The remaining 140 include settlements and operational exits; track their outcomes separately rather than labeling them arbitration losses.

label: Favorable determinations; value: 420 of 560; 75.0%; numeric value: 420.0; detail: Record 420 favorable determinations by the observation date. Split the other 140 among pending, adverse, and dismissed cases in the case ledger; do not treat every non-favorable observation as a final merits loss.

label: Incremental cash received; value: 280 of 420; 66.7%; numeric value: 280.0; detail: Match incremental receipts for 280 favorable cases to bank activity. The other 140 favorable cases have no matched incremental cash at this cutoff. Partial receipts support fees only on their actual net collected amount.

text.title: Assumptions: Illustrative cohort counts, not observed performance or the canonical annual revenue model. Every stage is a subset of the preceding stage. Negotiated settlements leave this arbitration funnel and enter a separate collection ledger. Unpaid awards remain receivables or disputed items, not earned contingency revenue under this cash-conditioned model.
